name: query_expenses
description: Read the current user's recorded, non-deleted expenses. Compose filters, date ranges and groupings dynamically. Dates use the user's local calendar; startDate inclusive, endDate exclusive, maximum 366 days. summary computes sum/count/average/largest across all matching records; details returns individual records. matchingTotal and matchingCount always cover all matches even when rows are truncated. Monetary amounts use the returned profile currency. weekday is ISO 1 Monday to 7 Sunday. nature is ESSENTIAL, DISCRETIONARY or UNKNOWN. Discover actual categories/merchants with a grouped summary before guessing exact labels. All filters are ANDed, text matching is case-insensitive. No income, balances, budgets or future obligations are available. No write operations.

groupBy.description: Empty for total or details. Up to two dimensions for summary.
